metadata.prompt: Describe this image and judge whether it is physically reasonable.
metadata.reference: A photorealistic macro shot of whole milk being poured into a black ceramic mug. The milk sinks slightly, creates realistic turbulent swirls with dark liquid, and forms accurate meniscus curves at the edges, studio lighting, no text, no watermark.
metadata.rationale: The milk density difference, turbulent mixing, and meniscus shape all follow standard fluid mechanics.
